description.narrative: The Facility for Energy Inclusion is split into two windows: 1) an ON-GRID WINDOW (FEI ON-GRID) which will support small-scale IPPs, mini-grids and captive power projects by providing long-term debt through project finance structures and 2) an OFF-GRID WINDOW (FEI OFF-GRID) which will support pay-as-you-go system companies (PAYGO) and other innovative energy access distribution companies through lending to loans corporates and SPVs.

description.narrative: 1) IPP distribution & transmission income ($m) per GWh generated: Assumes $0.03c/kWh D&T margin between utility wholesale electricity cost and final retail tariff. In some markets margin is higher but in other markets D&T revenue may not flow to government or may be offset by tariffs that are set below the true cost of electricity. 2) VAT income as % of project cost for OGS: In most major markets, SHS now appears to be exempt; this assumes a minority of countries (2025%) countries are still collecting VAT @ typical 1015% rates, or may once the technology is established. 3)
